plan.title: Add oxlint and rules to repository root
plan.overview: Install oxlint as a root devDependency and create .oxlintrc.json at the repository root with rules mapped from a provided ESLint configuration. Add a lint script to root package.json, a lint task to turbo.json, and remove the dead eslint lint script from apps/vscode/package.json. This follows the existing pattern of root-level tooling config (like tsconfig.base.json) and root devDependencies for shared tools (like turbo, typescript).

approach.rationale:
Following two existing patterns: - Root-level tooling config: shared config files live at repo root (tsconfig.base.json:1) - Root devDependencies for shared tools: turbo, typescript at package.json:19-22
Oxlint is configured via .oxlintrc.json (JSON format, not JS/TS flat config). Rules are mapped from the user-provided ESLint configuration. Unsupported plugins (perfectionist, tsdoc) are skipped per spec constraints. The turbo lint task follows the same pattern as the existing build/typecheck/clean tasks in turbo.json.

task.name: Create .oxlintrc.json configuration file
task.action:
- Create .oxlintrc.json at repository root - Add $schema reference: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oxc-project/oxc/main/npm/oxlint/configuration_schema.json" - Enable plugins: ["eslint", "typescript", "import"] - Set ignorePatterns: ["node_modules", "dist", ".turbo", "coverage", "scripts"] - Enable correctness category as baseline in categories: { "correctness": "error" } - Map all 9 rules from the inventory:
Target .oxlintrc.json structure: ```json { "$schema": "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oxc-project/oxc/main/npm/oxlint/configuration_schema.json", "plugins": ["eslint", "typescript", "import"], "ignorePatterns": ["node_modules", "dist", ".turbo", "coverage", "scripts"], "categories": { "correctness": "error" }, "rules": { "eslint/sort-imports": "warn", "typescript/no-useless-constructor": "off", "typescript/no-extraneous-class": "off", "typescript/no-non-null-assertion": "off", "typescript/no-dynamic-delete": "off", "typescript/no-explicit-any": "off", "typescript/no-empty-object-type": "off", "typescript/no-unused-vars": ["error", { "argsIgnorePattern": "^_", "varsIgnorePattern": "^_" }], "eslint/no-empty-pattern": "off" } } ```
task.done: .oxlintrc.json exists at repo root with $schema, plugins, ignorePatterns, categories, and all 9 rules configured

task.name: Install oxlint and add lint script to root package.json
task.action:
- Install oxlint as devDependency: pnpm add -D oxlint -w - Add "lint": "oxlint" to the scripts section
Current scripts section (package.json:6-17): ```json "scripts": { "dev": "turbo dev", "build": "turbo build", "clean": "turbo clean", "typecheck": "turbo typecheck", ... } ```
Add after existing scripts: ```json "lint": "oxlint" ```
task.done: oxlint is in root devDependencies and "lint": "oxlint" script exists in root package.json

task.name: Add lint task to turbo.json
task.action:
- Add a "lint" task definition to turbo.json tasks object - Follow the pattern of existing tasks (build, typecheck, clean) - Lint does not depend on build outputs, so no dependsOn needed - Set cache: false (lint results depend on source files, not build artifacts)
Current turbo.json tasks: ```json "tasks": { "build": { ... }, "dev": { ... }, "typecheck": { ... }, "clean": { ... } } ```
Add: ```json "lint": { "cache": false } ```
task.done: turbo.json has a lint task definition and running pnpm lint executes oxlint without configuration errors

task.name: Remove dead eslint lint script from apps/vscode/package.json
task.action:
- Remove the "lint": "eslint src --ext ts" line from apps/vscode/package.json scripts section - This script is dead code — no .eslintrc file exists in apps/vscode/
Current (apps/vscode/package.json:199): ```json "lint": "eslint src --ext ts", ```
Remove this line entirely.
task.done: apps/vscode/package.json no longer has a "lint" script

task.name: Verify oxlint lints both app directories
task.action: - Run oxlint from the repo root: pnpm lint - Verify it scans files in apps/vscode/src/ and apps/festinalente/src/ - Verify no configuration errors occur - Note: lint violations in existing code are expected and out of scope
task.verify: Manual: Run pnpm lint and confirm it lints both apps/vscode/src and apps/festinalente/src without configuration errors
task.done: oxlint successfully lints both app directories from repo root without configuration errors

testing.automated: No automated tests required — this is tooling configuration, not application code
testing.manual: - Run pnpm lint from repo root and verify oxlint executes successfully - Verify .oxlintrc.json is picked up (rules are applied) - Verify ignored directories (node_modules, dist, .turbo, coverage, scripts) are not linted - Verify both apps/vscode/src and apps/festinalente/src are scanned
testing.regression: - Verify pnpm build still succeeds (turbo.json change doesn't break build task) - Verify pnpm typecheck still succeeds - Verify apps/vscode package still builds without the removed lint script

case.scenario: oxlint finds lint violations in existing code

edge-cases.case: Out of scope per spec — violations are expected and will be fixed separately

case.scenario: oxlint rule name doesn't match expected format

edge-cases.case: All 9 rules in inventory are verified oxlint equivalents from scoping research

case.scenario: turbo tries to run lint in sub-packages without lint script

edge-cases.case: turbo lint will only run in packages that define a lint script — after removing eslint from vscode, only root has lint

pitfall.issue: oxlint config schema URL may change

pitfalls.pitfall: Use the canonical GitHub raw URL from oxc-project/oxc repository for the $schema reference
Expected behavior — pnpm-lock.yaml changes should be committed with the implementation

pitfall.issue: turbo lint may not work at root level

pitfalls.pitfall: The root package.json lint script runs oxlint directly, not through turbo — turbo lint is for orchestration if sub-packages add lint scripts later
